name: Camping 101: Mining

angles.text: Miners learn how to apply their gathering craft directly to field survival by preparing a lodestone for expedition camps.
The instruction takes miners to Brek Stonehoof atop the mesas of Thunder Bluff, drawing upon tauren knowledge of stone and earthcraft.
Horde expeditioners resting around a miner's campfire benefit from the prepared lodestone, bolstering their frontline combatants for upcoming battles.

faq.answer: A crafted lodestone placed at a camp radiates subtle martial properties, offering extra combat prowess and vigor to warriors and adventurers gathering around the campfire.
faq.q: What does the lodestone do for a campsite?

faq.answer: Brek Stonehoof is located in the tauren capital of Thunder Bluff. He instructs experienced miners on how to craft specialized camping utilities from extracted stone and ore.
Miners must first demonstrate foundational proficiency in their mining craft before Brek Stonehoof will teach them the techniques needed to construct a lodestone.
faq.q: When can a miner learn how to craft a lodestone?

faq.answer: Anyone looking to swing a weapon benefits from a lodestone's presence, as its influence offers physical combatants extra martial strength when they rest beside it.
faq.q: Who benefits most from a miner's lodestone?

faq.answer: Beyond supplying smelters and blacksmiths with raw metal, mining allows wilderness travelers to fashion sturdy stone utilities like lodestones that enhance survival camps in the wild.
faq.q: How does mining tie into establishing a campsite?

faq.answer: Camping 101: Mining is an instructional directive directing aspiring miners to Thunder Bluff so they may learn to craft field utilities suitable for wilderness survival.
faq.q: What is the purpose of Camping 101: Mining?

sections.body: Mining may lack the flash and elegance of high arcana, but it remains foundational, honest labor across Azeroth. Practitioners pull useful minerals and dense stone from deep rock faces, providing essential materials for weapons, armor, and now practical field craft. Through the craft of camping, miners can shape extracted stone into rugged enhancements for their wilderness stops.
sections.title: Honest Labor in the Earth

sections.body: For prospectors seeking to turn their trade toward survival, Brek Stonehoof in Thunder Bluff offers specialized instruction. Once a miner exhibits proper proficiency with their pick, Brek shares the craft of shaping a camp lodestone. Positioned beside an open blaze, the stone offers martial vigor and vital edge to anyone preparing to swing a blade in battle.
sections.title: The Lodestone of Thunder Bluff

summary: Camping 101: Mining introduces miners to the craft of wilderness survival through their trade. By seeking out Brek Stonehoof in Thunder Bluff, miners learn how to fashion a specialized lodestone that bolsters the combat prowess of adventurers resting by the campfire.
